info.title: Italic API
info.description: One account recording library. Text and metadata sync; audio stays local. Clip audio is temporary until successful transcription; Memo audio remains on its originating client.

get.summary: List account devices without pairing credentials
get.description: Required token scope: settings:read. Signed-in Italic sessions are also accepted.

200.description: Successful response. Integration imports without recordings:read return only id and revision.

403.description: Insufficient scope, different importing application, or session required.

409.description: Revision, immutable metadata or idempotency conflict.

429.description: Rate limited; retry after Retry-After seconds.
